description:
Get the weather forecast for any latitude/longitude in the world, or a US street address: the next 7 days in day and night periods (temperature, rain, wind, summary). US locations use the National Weather Service and include any active watches, warnings or advisories; elsewhere the forecast is from MET Norway (in °C and km/h).

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: You need the forecast for a place.
Use instead: airport_delays for flight delays; geocode_address when you need coordinates for something else.
Parameters: Give lat and lon (anywhere in the world) or address (US street addresses only). periods: 1-14 twelve-hour periods, default 14 (7 days).
Returns: forecast[] with name, start and end, temperature, rain, wind and a summary; in the US, active NWS alerts too.

address.description: US street address instead of lat/lon, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC".

lat.description: Latitude, e.g. 38.90 (anywhere in the world). Give lat and lon, or a US address.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: weather_forecast
title: Weather forecast and alerts
